PublicUser.title: PublicUser
PublicUser.description: Public, non-PII user directory card used to discover friends and display Guess Who options.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Display name shown on profile cards and Guess Who quiz options.

avatarUrl.description: Profile avatar URL or generated SVG data URI.

status.description: Short status line on the public card.

discoverable.description: Whether the user appears in the friend discovery directory.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the public profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the public profile was last updated.

PrivateUser.title: PrivateUser
PrivateUser.description: Owner-only private user record isolating email and personal metadata.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the private user doc was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private user doc was updated.

Friendship.title: Friendship
Friendship.description: Friend request and accepted friendship edge between two WhisperLink users.

participants.description: Sorted two-element array of participant UIDs [uidA, uidB].

requesterId.description: UID of the user who initiated the friend request.

recipientId.description: UID of the user receiving the friend request.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the friend relationship.

/publicUsers/{userId}.description: Public directory profiles without PII for friend search and Guess Who selection.

/users/{userId}.description: Private owner-only user records holding verified email PII.

/friendships/{friendshipId}.description: Canonical friend request and accepted friendship edges keyed by sorted participant UIDs.
